verdicts.reason: A is unusable. The three flavour names are stacked in a text column under the headline, in the wrong order, and cut off from their descriptors. The descriptors are listed separately in yet another order, so no name matches its line. The cans are wildly mismatched in scale: one is huge on the left and two are tiny and orphaned in the bottom right. The CTA is jammed into the top-right corner next to the logo. The fine print is as loud as the headline. The bottom-left half of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the original's centred stack: logo, headline, three evenly spaced cans with their names and descriptors grouped under each, body copy, CTA and delivery note. On the wider square it only needs minor polish: the cans and type look slightly small for the canvas, and the outer columns leave wide side gutters.
